newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ICTSI 1996 net sharply up on volume growth.
newsitem.headline: ICTSI 1996 net sharply up on volume growth.

text.p: International Container Terminal Services Inc (ICTSI) said on Friday it logged a 65 percent jump in net income in 1996 to 474.7 million pesos from 286.7 million in 1995.
It said the profits growth came from a 20 percent increase in container volume and income from foreign subsidiaries.
The 1995 profit excludes a one-time gain of 33.9 million pesos from the sale of shares of EEI Corp, it said.
ICTSI is the operator of the Manila International Container Terminal (MICT) where about 60 to 70 percent of the country's container traffic passes.

Revenues in 1996 grew by 17 percent to 2.547 billion pesos from 2.181 billion pesos in 1995 while volume handled at the MICT rose 20 percent to 848,017 twenty foot equivalent units (TEUs) from 708,181 TEUs, the company said.
Overseas units in Argentina and Mexico swung to a gain of 74.6 million pesos in 1996 from a loss of 44.6 million pesos in the previous year, ICTSI said.
Its container terminal in Buenos Aires, Argentina, handled 175,500 TEUs and the port in Veracruz, Mexico had 193,675 TEUs.

The company said its operating expenses increased by 20 percent to 1.089 billion pesos in 1996 from 906 milion pesos largely due to an increase in manpower cost which comprised 30 percent of total expenses.
